title: mouroucoa sikkimensis

Mouroucoa sikkimensis contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects.
